parameters.query:
INSERT INTO locations (location_id, city, latitude, longitude, source, source_url, parser_version, collected_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::timestamptz, now())
ON CONFLICT (location_id) DO UPDATE SET
  city = EXCLUDED.city, latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude, longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude,
  source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url, parser_version = EXCLUDED.parser_version,
  collected_at = EXCLUDED.collected_at, updated_at = now()
WHERE (locations.city, locations.latitude, locations.longitude)
      IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.city, EXCLUDED.latitude, EXCLUDED.longitude);

INSERT INTO observations (observation_id, location_id, observation_time_utc, day_code,
  temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_min, precipitation_sum, source, source_url, parser_version, collected_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::timestamptz, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11::timestamptz, now())
ON CONFLICT (observation_id) DO UPDATE SET
  temperature_2m_max = EXCLUDED.temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_min = EXCLUDED.temperature_2m_min,
  precipitation_sum = EXCLUDED.precipitation_sum, source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url,
  parser_version = EXCLUDED.parser_version, collected_at = EXCLUDED.collected_at, updated_at = now()
WHERE (observations.temperature_2m_max, observations.temperature_2m_min, observations.precipitation_sum)
      IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.temperature_2m_max, EXCLUDED.temperature_2m_min, EXCLUDED.precipitation_sum);
